reaction_equations: CH3/C0 Zn/C0 CH3 þ H2O ! ZnO þ 2CH4
C2H5/C0 Zn/C0 C2H5 þ H2O ! ZnO þ 2C2H6
surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves the chemical reaction of dimethylzinc (DMZn) and diethylzinc (DEZn) with water to form ZnO and corresponding hydrocarbons (CH4 and C2H6).
evidence: We used two different and very reactive organic zinc precursors, i.e., DMZn and DEZn. DEZn is composed of zinc bonded to two ethyl groups, whereas DMZn is composed of zinc bonded to two methyl groups. As an oxygen source, deionized water was used. ZnO ﬁlms were deposited at 3008C as a product of the double-exchange chemical reaction of DMZn with water: CH3/C0 Zn/C0 CH3 þ H2O ! ZnO þ 2CH4 or chemical reaction of DEZn with water: C2H5/C0 Zn/C0 C2H5 þ H2O ! ZnO þ 2C2H6:
